description: This file defines the Java interface `MappingConfig` which provides configuration settings for the message mapping behavior within the Connectivity service of the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for retrieving configuration parameters and an enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: MappingConfig
classes.description: An interface that specifies configuration parameters for message mapping behavior, including buffer size, parallelism, max pool size, and related configuration objects. It also contains an enumeration for default config values.

classes.name: MappingConfig.MappingConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values utilized in MappingConfig.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the buffer size used for the queue in the message mapping processor actor responsible for enrichment.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the parallelism level used for enriching messages in parallel.

methods.name: getMaxPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum pool size (parallelism) for mapping inbound and outbound messages, limited by user-settable configuration.

methods.name: getJavaScriptConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration of the JavaScript message mapping.

methods.name: getMapperLimitsConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration related to mapper limits.
